machine: MacBook M3 Pro 18GB, internal NVMe, macOS Darwin 25.5.0
note: 32 GB file reduced to 14 GB (internal disk had 21 GB free); cache purged before every measurement. Run 2 of 2 shown; run 1 within 5% on all metrics.
key_finding: macOS mmap page-fault path caps at ~1.4-1.9 GB/s regardless of prefetch strategy (WILLNEED, F_RDADVISE, 8 threads), while pread into shared MTLBuffers sustains 4.0-4.2 GB/s with the GPU consuming concurrently — full SSD speed. Engine must use pread-into-buffer-pool, NOT mmap faulting, for bulk weight streaming. This inverts the llama.cpp folk wisdom (mmap-first) on Apple Silicon. Also: 16 KB random reads collapse to 0.13 GB/s -> expert blocks must be laid out contiguously (>=2 MB granularity, 0.5 GB/s) or batched via pread.
